product_increment.title: Transparent model routing and delivery telemetry
product_increment.intent: A contributor can see why a model and instruction route was selected, while the harness preserves independent review, privacy, authority, and enough telemetry to judge whether routing improves accepted delivery outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: The provider-neutral route contract passes all canonical and adversarial authority, privacy, lifecycle, and fallback cases.
The current immutable checkpoint receives a fresh independent exact-HEAD review with no blocker or critical finding.
The reviewed checkpoint reaches accepted main through the normal integration owner.
At least five representative tasks compare route, time, cost, retries, corrections, review findings, rework, and accepted outcome.
Product records GO, NARROW, or STOP from measured value without granting the router admission or acceptance authority.

concurrency.below_target_reason: This is one cohesive eight-path contract. Portfolio capacity, rather than artificial subdivision, supplies parallel work.

integration_checks: Verify the delivery checkpoint is one commit whose sole parent is the accepted base and excludes every archived rejected checkpoint.
Run the complete deterministic routing and adversarial regression suite.
Run a fresh independent exact-HEAD review and unchanged-head guard.
After merge, run the five-task value canary before Product acceptance or P2 admission.

lanes.title: Provider-neutral router contract
lanes.result: The harness can select and disclose a bounded route without silently changing authority, review independence, privacy, or execution depth.
focused_checks: Verify exact eight-path scope and direct-child lineage.
Reject provider, adapter, model, effort, authority, privacy, lifecycle, cost, or review-route substitution.
Retain value-free privacy diagnostics and no network or dispatch side effects.

provides.summary: Provider-neutral route selection, disclosure, authority validation, and privacy-safe outcome telemetry.
